files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to digital PDFs (reports, invoices, bank statements, contracts). Scanned PDFs need the OCR Actor first.

output.title: Convert to
output.description: Word keeps the text flow (paragraphs, fonts, bold/italic). Excel puts tables into cells, with numbers and dates as real values.

sheets.title: Excel sheets
sheets.description: One sheet for the whole PDF (a table header repeated on every page is kept once), or one sheet per page.

convertNumbers.title: Numbers and dates as values
convertNumbers.description: Turns 1.234,56 / 1,234.56, percentages and dates into real Excel numbers (decimal style detected per file), so formulas work.

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only the first pages are converted; each page is charged.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
